name: Wood Thrush
facts: Call pattern: a flute-like "ee-oh-lay" ending in a shimmering trill. The bird sings two notes at once using both sides of its voice box.
Habitat: the shaded interior of mature deciduous forest, where it forages in leaf litter.
Migration: long-distance. Flies across the Gulf of Mexico to winter in Central America.
